title: chaiturus marrubiastrum
intro: Chaiturus marrubiastrum, commonly known as Marrubium, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Chaiturus marrubiastrum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing fever, soothing digestive issues, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects.
